# Cascader

Cascader picks a value from options nested in several levels, such as region → city → district or category →
subcategory; each level opens in its own column. Add `showSearch` to search across all levels, and `multiple` for
several values.

**Interaction**: a borderless well by default, like Select. `↓` or `Enter` opens the columns; `↑` / `↓` move within a column,
`→` opens the next level and `←` goes back; `Enter` picks the highlighted option; `Esc` closes the columns. Focus
stays in the input.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Regions and addresses, nested categories, choosing a folder by path

## Import

```ts
import { Cascader } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Each level opens in its own column; `→` opens the next level and `←` goes back.

```tsx
import { Cascader } from 'vellum-ui'

const regions = [
  {
    value: 'europe',
    label: 'Europe',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'germany',
        label: 'Germany',
        children: [
          { value: 'berlin', label: 'Berlin' },
          { value: 'munich', label: 'Munich' },
        ],
      },
      {
        value: 'france',
        label: 'France',
        children: [{ value: 'paris', label: 'Paris' }],
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    value: 'asia',
    label: 'Asia',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'japan',
        label: 'Japan',
        children: [
          { value: 'tokyo', label: 'Tokyo' },
          { value: 'osaka', label: 'Osaka' },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
]

export function Basic() {
  return <Cascader options={regions} placeholder="Select an office" />
}
```

## Variants

### Search and multiple selection

`showSearch` searches across all levels; `multiple` picks several values.

```tsx
import { Cascader, Stack } from 'vellum-ui'

const regions = [
  {
    value: 'europe',
    label: 'Europe',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'germany',
        label: 'Germany',
        children: [
          { value: 'berlin', label: 'Berlin' },
          { value: 'munich', label: 'Munich' },
        ],
      },
      {
        value: 'france',
        label: 'France',
        children: [{ value: 'paris', label: 'Paris' }],
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    value: 'asia',
    label: 'Asia',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'japan',
        label: 'Japan',
        children: [
          { value: 'tokyo', label: 'Tokyo' },
          { value: 'osaka', label: 'Osaka' },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
]

export function Variants() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Cascader options={regions} showSearch placeholder="Search offices" block />
      <Cascader options={regions} multiple placeholder="Select offices" block />
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

  {
    value: 'asia',
    label: 'Asia',
    children: [

        value: 'japan',
        label: 'Japan',

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly CascaderOption<V>[]` | The options of the first level. | — | Yes |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Text shown while nothing is chosen. | — | No |
| `showSearch` | `boolean` | Lets the user type to search across all levels. | — | No |
| `allowClear` | `boolean` | Shows a clear button while something is chosen. | `true` | No |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables the field. | — | No |
| `block` | `boolean` | Fills the width of the container. | — | No |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density. | — | No |
| `variant` | `'outlined' \| 'filled' \| 'borderless'` | Appearance: `filled` (a borderless well in the surface, the default), `outlined` (surface background with a thin border) or `borderless`. | `'filled'` | No |
| `status` | `'error' \| 'warning'` | Validation status, usually set by Form.Item. | — | No |
| `id` | `string` | Id of the input element, so that a `<label for>` can point to it (Form.Item sets it). | — | No |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible name, when there is no visible label. | — | No |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` | Id of the element that labels the input. | — | No |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | Id of the element that describes the input, such as a hint. | — | No |
| `data-testid` | `string` | Test id, output as `data-testid`. | — | No |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | Focuses the input when it mounts. | — | No |
| `onFocus` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | Called when the input gets the focus. | — | No |
| `onBlur` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | Called when the input loses the focus. | — | No |
| `onKeyDown` | `(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | Called on key presses in the input. | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Modes

The props of Cascader depend on how it is used. The props in the table above apply to every mode; the props below differ between the modes, and TypeScript checks the combination you pass.

### Single selection (default)

The value is the path from the first level to the chosen option, such as `['asia', 'cn', 'shanghai']`; `null`
when nothing is chosen.

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `multiple` | `false` | Allows choosing several options; the value becomes an array of paths. | — | No |
| `showChecked` | `undefined` | With `multiple`: when all children of an option are chosen, show only the `parent` or only the `child` options. | — | No |
| `value` | `readonly V[] \| null` | Path of the chosen option, from the first level (controlled), such as `['asia', 'cn', 'shanghai']`. | — | No |
| `defaultValue` | `readonly V[] \| null` | Initial path (uncontrolled). | — | No |
| `onChange` | `(value: V[] \| null) => void` | Called with the new path; `null` when cleared. | — | No |

### Multiple selection: `multiple`

Options are chosen with checkboxes, and the value is an array of paths. Choosing an option chooses all its
children; `showChecked` decides whether a fully chosen option is kept as one path or as the paths of its children.

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `multiple` | `true` | Allows choosing several options; the value becomes an array of paths. | — | Yes |
| `showChecked` | `'parent' \| 'child'` | When all children of an option are chosen, show only the `parent` (the default) or only the `child` options. | `'parent'` | No |
| `value` | `readonly (readonly V[])[] \| null` | Paths of the chosen options (controlled). | — | No |
| `defaultValue` | `readonly (readonly V[])[] \| null` | Initial paths (uncontrolled). | — | No |
| `onChange` | `(value: V[][]) => void` | Called with the new paths. | — | No |

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### CascaderOption<V>

An option of Cascader; `children` are the options of the next level.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `V` | Value of the option. | — | Yes |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | Text of the option. | — | Yes |
| `children` | `readonly CascaderOption<V>[]` | Options of the next level. | — | No |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | The option cannot be chosen. | — | No |
